标题: 首次问候｜自我介绍
英文即时消息: Hi [Name], thanks for reaching out to [Company]! How can I help you today?
中文对照: 你好 [Name]，感谢联系 [Company]！今天有什么可以帮您？

标题: 询问需求｜睫毛需求确认
英文即时消息:
Thanks for your interest in our lashes! To recommend the best options, could you tell me:
1. Style (classic / volume / mega volume)?
2. Length and curl (e.g. [Length], [Curl])?
3. Estimated order quantity for [Brand]?
4. Target market: [Country]?
5. Do you need private label packaging?
中文对照:
感谢关注我们的睫毛！为了给您推荐合适的款式，请问：
1. 风格（经典/浓密/超浓密）？
2. 长度和卷度（如 [Length]、[Curl]）？
3. [Brand] 的预估订单量？
4. 目标市场：[Country]？
5. 是否需要自有品牌包装？
使用备注: 先问清楚再报价，不要一上来就发价格表

标题: 询问需求｜假发规格确认
英文即时消息:
Great to hear you're interested in our hair products. Could you share the details below so I can prepare an accurate quote?
- Hair type: raw / virgin / Remy
- Texture: straight, body wave, deep wave
- Length: [Length] inches
- Lace type: HD / transparent, closure or frontal
- Density: 150% / 180% / 200%
- Quantity: [Quantity] pcs
If you already have reference photos, feel free to send them too.
中文对照:
很高兴您对我们的发制品感兴趣。请提供以下信息，方便我准备准确报价：
- 发质：原生/未加工/Remy
- 纹理：直发、身体波、深波
- 长度：[Length] 英寸
- 蕾丝类型：HD/透明，闭合或前蕾丝
- 密度：150%/180%/200%
- 数量：[Quantity] 件
如有参考图也可以一起发给我。

标题: 非目标客户｜礼貌婉拒
英文即时消息: Thank you for your inquiry. Unfortunately our products are not a good fit for your current needs, but we really appreciate your interest and wish you every success with your business.
中文对照: 感谢您的询盘。很遗憾我们的产品目前不太符合您的需求，但非常感谢您的关注，祝生意顺利。

标题: 阿里巴巴站内信｜完整公司介绍
英文即时消息:
Dear [Name],

Thank you for your message on Alibaba.com. We are [Company], a professional manufacturer of eyelash extensions, tweezers and hair products with more than 10 years of experience.

What we offer:
• Factory direct prices with stable quality control (3 inspections before shipping)
• Low MOQ for new brands and free design support for private label
• Worldwide express delivery (DHL / FedEx / UPS) within 3–7 working days
• Samples available for testing before bulk orders

You can see our latest catalog here: [Catalog Link]
Our certificates (MSDS, SGS, FDA) are available on request.

If you tell me your target market and estimated quantity, I will send you a detailed quotation within 24 hours.

Looking forward to working with you.

Best regards,
[Sender]
[Company] | WhatsApp: [Phone]
中文对照:
亲爱的 [Name]：

感谢您在阿里巴巴上的留言。我们是 [Company]，专业生产睫毛、镊子和发制品，拥有 10 年以上经验。

我们提供：
• 工厂直销价格，质量稳定（发货前三次检验）
• 新品牌低起订量，自有品牌免费设计支持
• 全球快递（DHL/FedEx/UPS）3–7 个工作日送达
• 大货前可先寄样测试

最新目录：[Catalog Link]
如需 MSDS、SGS、FDA 证书可提供。

告诉我目标市场和预估数量，我会在 24 小时内发详细报价。

期待合作。

此致
[Sender]
[Company] | WhatsApp：[Phone]
使用备注: 长文本，用来测试展开和滚动

标题: 首次问候｜二次问候
英文即时消息: Hello again [Name]! Just checking whether you had a chance to look at the catalog I sent earlier.
中文对照: [Name] 你好！想确认下您是否看过我之前发的目录。

标题: 样品政策｜说明样品费
英文即时消息: We are happy to send samples. The sample fee is [Sample Fee] and it will be fully refunded when you place a bulk order over [MOQ] sets. Shipping is paid by the buyer.
中文对照: 我们很乐意寄样。样品费为 [Sample Fee]，当您下单超过 [MOQ] 套时全额退还。运费由买家承担。
使用备注: 样品费金额和起订量需要先和老板核实
可替换变量: 样品费, 运费, 退款条件

标题: 样品寄出｜发送运单号
英文即时消息: Hi [Name], your samples have been shipped via [Courier]. Tracking number: [Tracking No]. It usually takes 3–5 working days. I will keep you updated, [Name]!
中文对照: [Name] 你好，您的样品已通过 [Courier] 寄出，运单号：[Tracking No]，通常 3–5 个工作日送达。我会随时同步进度，[Name]！

标题: 样品反馈｜收到样品后跟进
英文即时消息: Hi [Name], did the samples arrive safely? We would love to hear your feedback on the curl, softness and band quality.
中文对照: [Name] 你好，样品顺利收到了吗？很想听听您对卷度、柔软度和底梗的反馈。

标题: 镊子规格｜发送规格参数
英文即时消息:
Our tweezers are made of Japanese stainless steel (SUS304):
- Tip precision: <0.1mm
- Models: Straight / 45° / L-shape / "Isolation" / 'Volume'
- Finish: matte & mirror, custom logo laser engraving available
- Package: single OPP bag, MOQ [MOQ] pcs per model
中文对照:
我们的镊子采用日本不锈钢（SUS304）：
- 尖端精度：<0.1mm
- 型号：直头/45°/L 型/隔离/浓密
- 表面：哑光和镜面，可定制 Logo 激光雕刻
- 包装：单个 OPP 袋，每款起订量 [MOQ] 件

标题: 成分说明｜洗发水成分
英文即时消息: Our shampoo is sulfate-free 🌿 with argan oil, keratin and aloe — gentle on extensions and natural hair ✨. Safe for lace and bonded hair. Free of parabens and silicones.

中文对照: 我们接受电汇、PayPal、西联和阿里巴巴信保。电汇请汇入：[Bank Account]。30% 定金，发货前付清 70% 尾款。

标题: 催付款｜礼貌催款

标题: 客户还价｜保持底价

英文即时消息:

定制包装需要：
1. Logo 文件（AI/PDF/PNG，优先矢量）
2. 盒子尺寸和材质（牛皮纸/白卡/磁吸盒）

标题: 打样确认｜确认样品修改

中文对照: 非常抱歉这次体验没有达到您的预期。您的反馈对我们很重要，方便私下联系解决吗？我们一定会妥善处理。
